title: MuteSenderInput
description: Keep or mute a subscription sender. Stored only in Call Guardian on this phone; nothing is sent.

sender.title: Sender
sender.description: Sender as shown by the SMS inbox or Google Voice (number, short code or name).

mode.title: Choice
mode.description: MUTE: no Call Guardian alerts for this sender. KEEP: you want these texts; hide from review. CLEAR: undo.

service.title: Service
service.description: Service these senders belong to, when grouped.

senders.title: Senders in this service
senders.description: Every sender number or name in the service group. Keep or mute applies to all of them.
